# Phase 1 — Information architecture

Everything needed to lock the site structure before visual design starts.

## Tasks

- [ ] Card-sort the existing content with five representative users
- [ ] Produce a proposed sitemap [vk](https://vikunja.example.com/tasks/110) <!--vk:110-->
- [ ] Map redirects from old URLs to new ones → [[Redirect map]]
- [ ] Review the draft IA with stakeholders and revise

## Notes that outgrew a line

When a task needs more than a line — supporting detail, a decision log, an
artifact — give it a wikilinked note and point to it from the line. The line
stays the task; the note holds what accreted around it.

- [[Redirect map]] — the working spreadsheet of old → new paths.
- [[Accessibility criteria]] — acceptance criteria shared from the kickoff.
